settings.policySummaryNote: Built-in rules check empty messages, oversized payloads, inline attachments, and message count. Blocklists override allowlists.
settings.remoteCompactThresholdNote: Default 0.8; local auto compact triggers when input tokens exceed the model budget ratio.
settings.remoteCompactThresholdTokensNote: Default 200000; official Responses compaction threshold is an absolute token limit.
settings.compactExecutionPolicyNote: Default is Auto: use provider-native remote compact when the provider declares support and context pressure reaches the threshold; otherwise local long-context compression keeps recent messages and summarizes older history. Off forces local only. Required blocks the request when provider support is missing.
settings.proxyBaseUrlNote: Custom URL keeps the original endpoint path and query string.
settings.observabilitySinkEndpointUrlNote: HTTPS for external sinks; localhost HTTP is development-only.
settings.observabilitySinkApiKeyNote: Stored in secure storage; diagnostics only read whether a key exists.
settings.sessionAffinityEnabled: Pin compatible requests to a credential group

settings.sessionAffinityTtlMsNote: How long a credential binding can be reused before it is refreshed.
settings.modelTestModelNote: Empty value uses the first synced available model.
settings.runtimeLogMaxBytesNote: Values below 4096 are treated as 4096; rotation keeps newest lines.
settings.listRuleNote: One per line or comma-separated; * wildcard is supported.

agent-workflow-android-download-organize.name: Android Download organizer
agent-workflow-android-download-organize.description: Requests scoped Android SAF access, scans Download, previews a reversible organization plan, then applies only user-confirmed operations.
agent-workflow-android-download-organize.checks: Use SAF directory access; scan and preview before write; apply only confirmed operations; refuse deletes and record audit.

agent-workflow-android-file-copy-rename.name: Android file copy / rename
agent-workflow-android-file-copy-rename.description: Requests scoped Android SAF access, previews one copy or rename from user-provided names, then applies it only after confirmation.
agent-workflow-android-file-copy-rename.checks: Stay inside the authorized tree; preview before write; refuse raw filesystem paths; keep originals; record audit.

agent-workflow-android-apk-install.name: Android APK installer handoff
agent-workflow-android-apk-install.description: Inspects an APK URI and opens the Android system installer; final install confirmation stays in the system UI.
agent-workflow-android-apk-install.checks: Require an APK URI; open system installer; disallow silent install; record audit.

agent-workflow-android-app-cache-cleanup.name: Android app-cache cleanup
agent-workflow-android-app-cache-cleanup.description: Reviews storage cleanup suggestions and clears only IsleMind-owned cache after visible confirmation.
agent-workflow-android-app-cache-cleanup.checks: Audit before cleanup; limit to app cache; require visible confirmation; never delete user files; record audit.

agent-workflow-android-alarm.name: Android alarm creation
agent-workflow-android-alarm.description: Binds the requested alarm time and asks Android Clock to create it, falling back to the system editor when confirmation is needed.
agent-workflow-android-alarm.checks: Require alarm time; request system clock creation; show system confirmation when needed; do not request exact-alarm permission; record audit.

agent-workflow-android-calendar-todo.name: Android calendar to-do handoff
agent-workflow-android-calendar-todo.description: Binds a to-do title and due time, then opens Android Calendar; the entry is created only after system-app confirmation.
agent-workflow-android-calendar-todo.checks: Require to-do title; open system calendar; require system confirmation; do not request calendar write permission; record audit.

agent-workflow-android-notification-sett.name: Android notification settings handoff
agent-workflow-android-notification-sett.description: Opens IsleMind's Android notification settings or promoted-notification settings; permission changes finish only in system UI.
agent-workflow-android-notification-sett.checks: Open system notification settings; support promoted notification settings; leave permission changes to system confirmation; avoid background-reply claims; record audit.

fallbackStrategies.embedding: When downloadable embedding models are unavailable, IsleMind falls back to hash embedding. It is useful offline, but it is not a semantic vector model.
fallbackStrategies.reranker: Reranker Lite improves result order with lexical overlap, chunk position, and quality signals; no dedicated Cross-Encoder model is loaded.
fallbackStrategies.colbert: ColBERT Lite uses token max-sim for complex-query recall; no dedicated multi-vector ColBERT model is loaded.
fallbackStrategies.compressor: Compressor Lite uses extractive compression that keeps citations and high-relevance sentences; no dedicated LLMLingua model is loaded.
